<p style="font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', 'Courier New', monospace !important; color: #333333 !important; font-size: large !important; line-height: 1.4;">
    The <i>Thirty-six Stratagems</i> is a sixth-century essay that describes a series of maneuvers used in politics and war, with an emphasis on the use of cunning and deception. It can be found in the <i>Book of Qi</i>'s seventh biographical volume, <i>Biography of Wáng Jìngzé</i>. The essay is divided into six chapters, each containing six stratagems; the first three chapters describe tactics to be used in advantageous situations, and the last three contain stratagems to be used in disadvantageous situations.
  </p>

<span style="color: #333333; font-family: inherit; font-size: x-large;"><b>First Stratagem</b></span></p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-family: inherit;"><br /></span>

</p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-family: inherit; font-size: x-large;"><span><span lang="zh-CN"><b>瞒天过海</b></span></span></span></p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-family: inherit; font-size: large;">(mán
tiān guò hǎi)</span></p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-family: inherit; font-size: large;"><br /></span>

</p>
<p class="western" style="font-weight: normal; line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="color: #333333; font-family: inherit; font-size: x-large;"><i>Deceive the Heavens to
Cross the Ocean</i></span></p>

<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-family: inherit; font-size: large;">
Disguise one's true intentions from those in authority who might lack
vision.</span></p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="color: #333333; font-family: inherit; font-size: large;"><br /></span>

</p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-family: inherit; font-size: large;">
This is the first of the thirty-six stratagems. The phrase refers to
643 A.D. when Tang Emperor Li Shimin (<span><span lang="zh-CN">李世民</span></span>,
598-649 A.D.), who feared seasickness, was invited to a cave by his
own general, Xue Rengui (<span><span lang="zh-CN">薛仁贵</span></span>,
614-683 A.D.), where they were to meet a wise man. In the cave they
feasted for several days until the emperor heard the sound of waves
and realized he had been lured onto a ship. The general drew aside a
curtain revealing the ocean, and confessed they had already crossed
the sea, after which the emperor carried on, successfully completing
the campaign [19], [24].</span></p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="color: #333333; font-family: inherit; font-size: large;"><br /></span>

</p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="color: #333333; font-family: inherit; font-size: large;"><i>Deceive the Heavens to Cross the Ocean</i> is associated with the
59th hexagram, <i>Wind over Water</i>. The persistent and penetrating
force of Wind overcomes the obstacle presented by Water [1], [28].</span></p>

</span></p><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-family: inherit;"></span></p><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-family: inherit;"></span><span style="color: #333333; font-family: inherit;">-------------------------------------</span></p><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-family: inherit;">&nbsp;</span></p><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-family: inherit;">&nbsp;</span>	

</p>

<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<b><span face="Noto Sans CJK SC Black, sans-serif" style="color: #333333; font-size: x-large;">Sample Sentences 1:</span></b></p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span>

</p>
<div dir="ltr" id="Section53" style="column-count: 2;"><div class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-align: left; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333;">
	<span style="font-size: large;">1) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">我从不在星期一跑步，但是我经常在星期</span></span>
	<span style="padding-left: 30px;">三跑步。</span></span></span></span></div>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: medium;">Trans.: I never run on
	Monday, but I always run on Wednesday. </span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"></p>
	<span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span>

  <span style="font-size: large;">
    <span style="color: #333333;">
      1) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">我总是在星期六去小店买东西。</span></span>
    </span>
  </span>
</p>

<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
  <span style="color: #333333; font-size: medium;">
    Trans.: I always go to the store to buy things on Saturday.
  </span>
</p>

<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
  <span style="font-size: large;">
    <span style="color: #333333;">
      <br />
    </span>
  </span>
</p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333; text-decoration: none;">3)</span><span style="color: #333333;"> </span><span style="color: #0047AB;"><span style="font-family: times; color: #0047AB;">我喜欢蓝天。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span>

  <span style="font-size: large;">
    <span style="color: #333333;">4) </span>
    <span style="color: #0047AB ; font-family: Times, serif;">他去过学校门口。</span>
  </span>
</p>

<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;">
  <span style="font-size: large;">
    <span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span>
  </span>
</p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;">
	5) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">你快准备好上学了吗？</span></span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;">
	6) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">这本书不容易看。</span></span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;">
	7) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">她喝的水不够。</span></span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;">
	8) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">他吃了太多的饭。</span></span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;">
	9) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">那棵树很高。</span></span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;">
	10) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">那只狗对他们很重要。</span></span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;">
	11) Q: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">你在准备做菜吗？</span></span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333; text-decoration: none;">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </span><span style="color: #333333; text-decoration: none;">A:
	<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">是的。但是饭太烫了。</span></span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333; text-decoration: none;">12)</span><span style="color: #333333;"> </span><span style="color: #0047AB ;"><span style="font-family: times; color: #0047AB !important;">她要去看海。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span>
	<div class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-align: left; text-decoration: none;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;">
	13) Q: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">这棵树是不是和我们昨天看到的一</span>
    </span>
	<span style="padding-left: 30px;">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;样？</span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333; text-decoration: none;">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </span><span style="color: #333333; text-decoration: none;">A:
	<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">不是。我们昨天看到的树和这棵树</span>
	</span>
	<span style="padding-left: 30px;">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;不一样。</span>
	</span></span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;">
	14) Q: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">这些东西是相同的，对不对？</span></span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333; text-decoration: none;">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </span><span style="color: #333333; text-decoration: none;">A:
	<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">不对。这些东西是不同的。</span></span></span></span></p>
</div>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333;"> <br /></span></p><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333;">&nbsp;-------------------------------------</span></p><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333;">&nbsp;</span></p><p>
